# Calculator Soup

> > Free online calculators for math, finance, physics, geometry, and everyday problem-solving.

Calculator Soup provides over 300 calculators covering mathematics (factorization, ratios, square roots), financial calculations (APR, compound interest, selling prices), physics formulas (momentum, weight, impulse), geometry (circles, 3D shapes), unit conversions, and practical tools like time clocks and dice rollers. Created by Edward Furey and operated by CalculatorSoup, LLC.

## Key Topics

- Math calculators (factorization, ratios, square roots, long division)
- Financial calculators (APR, compound interest, Rule of 72)
- Physics calculators (momentum p=mv, weight W=mg, impulse J=Ft)
- Geometry (circles, 3D solid shapes, area and volume formulas)
- Prime factorization and factor pairs
- Significant figures and scientific notation
- Selling price and profit margin calculators
- Nominal and effective interest rates
- Unit conversions (acceleration, physics units)
- Online marketplace pricing (Amazon, eBay, Etsy)
- Composite numbers and trial division
- Time tracking and clock calculators
- Markup calculation and pricing strategies
- Educational math resources (Khan Academy integration)

## Mathematics Calculators

- [Square Root Calculator](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/algebra/squareroots.php): Find square roots, principal roots & check perfect squares
- [Ratio Calculator](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/math/ratios.php): Solve ratio problems A:B = C:D, proportions & equivalent fractions
- [Long Division Calculator with Decimals](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/math/longdivisiondecimals.php): Step-by-step long division with decimal numbers showing work
- [Significant Figures Counter](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/math/significant-figures-counter.php): Count sig figs in numbers, decimals & scientific notation with rules
- [Absolute Difference Calculator](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/algebra/absolute-difference-calculator.php): Calculate absolute difference between two numbers with step-by-step work
- [Factors of 24 | Factorization Calculator](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/math/factors/24): Find all 8 factors and 4 factor pairs of 24 with prime factorization
- [Factors of 8 | Factorization Calculator](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/math/factors/8): Find all 4 factors and 2 factor pairs of 8 with prime factorization

## Financial Calculators

- [Selling Price Calculator](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/financial/selling-price-calculator.php): Calculate selling prices for Amazon, eBay, Etsy to cover costs & profit
- [APR Calculator](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/financial/apr-calculator.php): Calculate Annual Percentage Rate from loan amount & finance charges
- [Nominal Interest Rate Calculator](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/financial/nominal-interest-rate-calculator.php): Calculate nominal annual interest rate or APY from compounding periods
- [Rule of 72 Calculator](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/financial/rule-of-72-calculator.php): Estimate investment doubling time using Rule of 72 compound interest
- [Interest and APR Calculators](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/financial/index-interest-apr-calculators.php): Index of interest rate calculators: simple, compound, APR, effective rates

## Physics Calculators

- [Momentum Calculator p = mv](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/physics/momentum.php): Calculate momentum, mass, or velocity using physics formula p = mv
- [Weight Calculator W = mg](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/physics/weight.php): Calculate weight from mass & gravity using Newton's formula W = mg
- [Impulse Calculator J = Ft](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/physics/impulse.php): Calculate impulse, force or time using momentum formula J = Ft

## Geometry Calculators

- [Circle Calculator](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/geometry-plane/circle.php): Calculate circle area, circumference, radius & diameter with formulas
- [Geometric Shapes and Formulas in Solid Geometry](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/geometry-solids/geometricshapes.php): 3D shape formulas: cone, cube, cylinder, pyramid, sphere volume & area

## Conversion and Unit Calculators

- [Acceleration Conversion Calculator](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/conversions/acceleration.php): Convert acceleration units: ft/s², m/s², galileo, gravity, knot/s, mph/s

## Time and Practical Tools

- [Time Clock Calculator | Clock-In Clock-Out](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/time/time-clock-calculator.php): Track work hours with clock-in/out time card & attendance tracker
- [Dice Roller](https://www.calculatorsoup.com/calculators/games/diceroll.php): Roll 1-6 virtual dice for Yahtzee, craps & other dice games online
